objective: Establish the IWB Phase 1 acceptance foundation: read the canonical IWB task ledger, prepare verifier-owned exact-SHA checkouts, add an IWB adapter, and support static/Mac plus simulator-first suite execution without real-device claims.
acceptance_criteria: IV can project active IWB tasks from the verifier-owned checkout and expose the exact ledger commit represented.
IV prepares an isolated IWB clone/check-out at an exact requested SHA without mutating the user's active IWB worktree.
The IWB adapter contains IWB-specific commands and paths while the generic runner remains product-neutral.
The first IWB suite can execute canonical Mac/mobile static validation and bind evidence to IWB task IDs.
Simulator requirements and device-required follow-ups remain explicitly separated; physical-device automation is deferred.
Reports expose the represented IWB ledger commit, exact tested commit, task references and run identity.
